notes.title: The new demo for Family Rise is now available!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone:[/p][p]After nearly a year of development, the new demo is now available. We welcome everyone to try it out. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment (great suggestions may be rewarded with a key for the official version). Have fun playing![/p]

notes.title: New Product Festival Trial Release Now~
Game opens live streaming activity
notes.content:
hi， Hello everyone, I am the developer of 'Rise of the Clans Simulator':
In order to better optimize and update the game, during the Steam New Product Festival, I will live stream trial content on the Steam platform and try my best to answer some of your questions. I look forward to your feedback!!

notes.title: Game Phase 2 Development Plan
The gameplay of 3-person brawl and 5-person brawl is open
notes.content:
Hello all players:
       The game has gained a lot of players since the demo was uploaded, some players feedback that it's not enjoyable to play, after thinking about it, I've decided to open up all the difficulties of the 3-player Smash Mode and the 5-player Smash Mode for players to experience~~~
       If you have any questions during your experience, please provide feedback within the forums, thank you!
